d:
This song is an ode to the deepest care that one can have for one's loved one in one's thoughts (khayaal). You are always in my thoughts with a wish that you take care of yourself. While I cannot see you physically coz you are so far away from me, every moment of the day I wish you well and pray for your well being.
Distance makes the heart grow fonder and I remember your little gestures with even greater fondness.
